items.title: Generate a Koala-managed Codex adapter manifest
items.context: Add .Codex/koala.json through koala init with fields that describe adapter ownership, recommended entrypoint, activity source, and excluded Claude runtime assets.

items.title: Harden the Codex wrapper and entrypoint verification
items.context: bin/koala-codex.js should remain the stable executable entry that tags source=codex/session, and tests should verify both wrapper behavior and the generated adapter manifest.

items.title: Document that Codex gets an adapter, not hooks/settings
items.context: Update .Codex/README template and root docs to explain the adapter manifest and why .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json are intentionally absent.
